aggregation_policy: Grade only assertions assigned to each case. Any failed critical assertion fails the case; a partial result without a critical failure makes the case partial. Count routing only from observable Skill file loads.
artifact_policy: Raw prompts, responses, JSONL, grader output, command traces, and disposable Git repositories were retained only under /tmp and are not part of this result.

iterations.reason: The runner wrote raw logs inside each fixture repository, so the grader correctly treated runner-owned files as repository mutations. No behavioral verdict from this run was reused.
Moving raw logs outside fixture repositories removed the harness mutation. The only partial result applied an option-terminator requirement to a git commit command with no pathspec.
The assertion was corrected to require -- only when a pathspec is present. Baseline and candidate were rerun under the same corrected grader contract.
The empty-HEAD fixture was changed from a committed then deleted marker to an empty commit. Removing the unrelated fixture deletion preserved the case verdicts.
Static review restored the previous summary-language precedence contract. Matched runs confirmed repository-rule override and user-language fallback.
